frameConvention: Zero-based decoded native source frame numbers, inclusive. Preview footage is a trimmed native source selection.

entries.title: Restaurant photo strip
entries.description: Browse five photos side to side while the restaurant name, action row, tabs and address stay fixed.
queries: browse photos while the place name stays fixed
entries.choose: Show the same venue from several angles while keeping the viewer oriented to one place and its next action.
entries.avoid: Use a different motion for sending attachments, switching between venues, or acquiring a new screen.

anatomy.moving: One horizontal rail containing five independent images. The image positions share the same x displacement.
anatomy.fixed: Venue name, detail line, action row, tabs, divider, address, and the photo viewport. All four tested text/control patches had zero integer x/y shift.
anatomy.mask: The restaurant document owns the bounded photo viewport. The viewport clips the rail. Individual images also own their corner masks.
anatomy.anchor: Viewport top left at source (195,303). The fixed venue name sits above it, outside the viewport.

phases.name: entry control
phases.observation: Mid-motion pose showing the clipped façade and a table photo. Earlier frames already show leftward travel.

phases.name: action
phases.observation: Façade and table translate left. The wide overhead food image enters from the right.

phases.name: action
phases.observation: The rail accelerates across the overhead photo and reaches the next plated dish.

phases.name: action
phases.observation: Plated dish and interior take over. Speed decreases but remains nonzero at the boundary.

phases.name: exit control
phases.observation: Rail moves about 37 px farther left. This control is part of the same observed action.

phases.name: horizontal settle outside event
phases.observation: The final interior approaches x≈320 by about 1130 and remains within ~2 px through 1134. The lower document/text changes separately after the event.

safe: Replace image files in the same five slots. Images use centered cover and stay independently editable.
Change adjacent copy/palette in an authored context. Check for overflow.
Move or uniformly scale the complete block via its parent.
changesInteraction: Changing count, slot width, gap, viewport, travel direction, duration or sample spacing changes the observed interaction.
A reading hold on the last event frame is an editorial freeze during the swipe.

cues.source: Source has an audio track. No isolated source swipe or finger/contact cue is established.

limits: The 21-frame preset is a mid-swipe extract. No release/contact, actual settled hold or exit occurs within it.
Offscreen objects and finger trajectory remain unknown. Sample arrivals and pauses are visible picture behavior.
Relative rail x is measured. Rounded corners, invisible image extents and isolated/context styling are authored approximations.

measurement.method: Integer edge measurements across y=355–589. Threshold median background difference, match photo edges/gutters across frames and register title, tabs, action and address patches independently. Compare positional repeats and adjacent controls before fitting. Native source frames were decoded without resampling.
measurement.uncertainty: Rail dx about ±2 px from thresholding/chroma/compression; 499 px bowl extent is a visible edge fit. The y boundary varies about 1 px, and fixed elements have zero integer x/y shift (subpixel/codec differences remain). Hidden façade extent is inferred from the retained crop. No hand or off-viewport trajectory is visible.
measurement.slotAssetProvenance: Existing individual source-derived component crops in Linq scene assets. No source page/movie is used as a moving layer.

entries.title: Typing indicator becomes a reply
entries.description: Convert waiting dots into a readable incoming reply at the same left-edge and tail anchor.
entries.choose: Make the transition from waiting to a single readable answer legible.
entries.avoid: Avoid for human composer typing, multiple separate replies, or any workflow with no visible waiting state.

source.title: Daniel Tian · Photon Agent to Agent

anatomy.moving: Incoming lozenge grows in width, dots fade away, reply resolves. The original thread has mild camera drift.
anatomy.fixed: Reply shares the incoming lane with the dots. The authored example keeps the previous outgoing turn and outer frame still.
anatomy.mask: Incoming bubble bounds own the content mask for the widening/reveal.
anatomy.anchor: Bubble left edge with its tail near the lower-left; text reveal is downstream of width growth.

phases.name: entry
phases.observation: Blurred low-contrast state grows into a readable three-dot indicator. A faint precursor was visible at 204.

phases.name: wait
phases.observation: Dots change emphasis within the small bubble.

phases.name: action
phases.observation: Surface widens in the same lane as the dots yield to a left-to-right reply reveal.

phases.name: settle and hold
phases.observation: Readable complete reply. No separate release or exit is visible.

safe: Change reply and preceding request. Keep the response short enough for one line.
Change palette or uniformly scale the mount.
changesInteraction: A multiline response requires new reveal and bubble geometry.
Stretching the dots hold changes perceived response latency.

cues.source: Source mix present. No keystroke or discrete dot sound is established.

options.detail: Optional quiet arrival when the reply is readable. Never sound dots individually.

limits: Native phase anchors with authored layout, dot cadence, blur, and widths. No claim of source-pixel trajectory parity.

entries.title: A selected option becomes an outgoing result
entries.description: Dim just the selected row, release it, then replace the list with a right-aligned conversation result.
entries.choose: Show that one committed choice became part of the conversation and can prompt a follow-up.
entries.avoid: Avoid for hover, a tentative choice, multiselect, or a shape morph between the row and the message.

anatomy.moving: Selected row ink changes opacity, list pulls back. The right-aligned result uses a separate actor and settles independently.
anatomy.fixed: Physical stage is the reference frame for these planes. The authored composer stays fixed.
anatomy.mask: Conversation viewport clips the separate list and result groups.
anatomy.anchor: Selected row stays inside the left list until cut. Result lands on the right message lane.

phases.name: entry
phases.observation: Existing list is readable before the press.

phases.name: action
phases.observation: Selected row reaches its dimmest opacity; neighboring rows remain readable.

phases.name: release
phases.observation: Row ink recovers as the parent list pulls back.

phases.name: handoff
phases.observation: List ends after 360. Outgoing result and the task label appear as new actors.

phases.name: settle
phases.observation: Result and camera settle. The next incoming response first appears around 375; no useful reading hold on that reply within this range.

safe: Replace the six labels and the selected label within the row width.
Change surface colors or uniformly scale the result.
changesInteraction: Moving a different row changes the selected result. Changing row count or timing changes the framing and pullback.

cues.source: Source mix present. Discrete cue attribution unconfirmed.

options.detail: Optional result/send accent at the cut.

limits: Stage runs at 30 fps by frame index; source is 30000/1001. Local geometry, easing and camera travel are authored.
Output frame numbers follow the matched director GSAP scan. Equal frame numbers do not imply identical content.

entries.title: Anchored rich-card arrival
entries.description: Let one actionable result grow from its position in chat, hold long enough to read, then darken just that card on press.
entries.choose: Give one meaningful rich result a clear arrival and a readable action beat.
entries.avoid: Avoid for routine replies, large bounces on every message, or a full-screen app opening.

anatomy.moving: Card shell and art scale and fade together; original thread and parent camera also move. Press overlay operates only inside the card.
anatomy.fixed: Card origin is stable inside the message stack. In the authored version the outer frame is stationary.
anatomy.mask: Conversation viewport contains the thread. The card owns the rounded press tint.
anatomy.anchor: Lower-left attachment lane under the agent reply. The block uses a near-upper-left origin for the new card inside that lane.

phases.name: entry
phases.observation: Tiny, low-confidence first image at the anchor.

phases.name: action
phases.observation: Fast growth to opaque; art reads before the later press.

phases.name: settle
phases.observation: Small scale overshoot near 555; camera and thread continue settling.

phases.name: reading hold
phases.observation: Card remains readable as its parent drifts into the final composition.

phases.name: press
phases.observation: Local card darkens.

phases.name: release
phases.observation: Tint clears.

phases.name: hold
phases.observation: Card remains before separate sheet arrival at 618.

safe: Replace card title, subtitle, action and colors within their boxes.
changesInteraction: Changing the anchor, press onset, meaning of the press, or camera timing changes the continuity.

cues.source: Source mix present. Visible motion supplies timing; source sound attribution is unconfirmed.

limits: The layout, image placeholder, scales and parent path are authored. Source card artwork and camera curve remain visible in the linked footage.

entries.title: Conversation opens a mini app
entries.description: Bring a clipped working panel up over a still-visible conversation so the preview becomes useful detail.
queries: expand conversation into a mini app
chat card expands to mini app
entries.choose: Show a recommendation leading to an interactive document on top of the conversation.
entries.avoid: Avoid when the whole experience leaves the conversation, or there is no visible app to use.

anatomy.moving: Independent foreground document fades in, travels upward and lands; the underlying thread softens.
anatomy.fixed: Chat stays on a separate plane. Foreground panel keeps its width while revealing through an anchored portal.
anatomy.mask: Panel own top corners plus a fixed vertical portal. Chat uses its own stage and blur.
anatomy.anchor: App portal centered at x≈188..772 on the 960×720 source. The authored stage places the portal on a new conversation.

phases.name: entry
phases.observation: Chat reply and compact preview are already readable.

phases.name: action
phases.observation: App panel arrives from low in the portal, initially translucent.

phases.name: settle
phases.observation: Panel resolves into a clear full-width document; background thread softens.

phases.name: hold
phases.observation: App is readable. Later scrolling is outside this entry; no exit or visible finger release.

safe: Change preview title, app title, detail copy and palette within their boxes.
changesInteraction: Repositioning the portal relative to chat, changing its clip, or extending into document scroll requires re-timing and new evidence.

cues.source: Source mix present. No actual tap/contact is visible or attributable.

options.detail: Optional opener tied to the first foreground frame.

limits: This shorter entrance is part of the existing 351–510 Linq chat-to-app study. Layout, geometry and easing of the playable version are authored.

entries.title: Native Messages attachment stack
entries.description: Send four product photos together as one native Messages attachment stack.
queries: four product images sent together as a native messages attachment stack
send multiple photos in one imessage
entries.choose: Show how multiple selected images appear together in an actual sent message.
entries.avoid: Do not use a restaurant gallery swipe, floating card orbit, or web carousel for the native send.
limits: Needs verified capture from imv/imessage-ui showing selection, send, native arrival and settled stack for four attachments. Source, tap path, overlap, offsets, clipping and cue timing are pending.
